name: Jidoushaya
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood car dealership: a business-hours notice, a first day working the reception desk, a free-inspection card info sheet, a trial online test-drive booking notice, a pick-up/drop-off plan guide, test-drive manners, teaching a junior how to explain a car, the history of the inspection-card system, a service guide, an online-research trend column, a hybrid test-drive booking system, a reflection on trust, and a one-year report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
